name: Davco Ultraprime
paste:
DAVCO ULTRAPRIME: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Ultraprime, June 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/davco-ultraprime.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Ultraprime where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - Acrylic surface primer designed to increase the bond strength of tile adhesives and waterproofing membranes on porous substrates.
    - Davco Ultraprime is suitable for both commercial and residential applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco Ultraprime can be applied to concrete and most common building substrates prior to the application of Davco adhesives and waterproofing systems.
    - Davco Ultraprime can be used prior to the application of adhesives or underlay.
    - Davco Ultraprime can be used both internally and externally on wall and floor substrates
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Suitable substrates include.
    - Concrete
    - Cement based screeds & renders
    - Fibro cement sheeting / Ceramic tile underlay
    - Porous Cement boards
    - Light weight construction board coated with cement
    - Autoclaved Aerated Concrete - AAC
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Ultraprime
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.2).
    - AS1884: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > SUBSTRATE QUALITY (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fast drying
    - Excellent coverage
    - Adhesion promoter of tile adhesives and waterproofing membranes
    - Primes and seals substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Grey
    - Appearance / Colour: Blue Liquid
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 1g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: 1.0 ± .05
    - Consumption: 1 litre of Ultraprime covers approximately 8-10m² (surface texture and site conditions can alter the coverage of any particular installation).
    - Drying Time: 30 Minutes
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in 1Ltr, 5Ltr jerry can and a 20Lt pail.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacture if unopened.
    - Storage conditions: Store off ground in a cool, dry, location out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, laitance, oil, grease, wax, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to priming
    - All concrete floors must be fully cured and dry, in accordance with AS1884. For substrates with a high moisture content or subject to rising damp, apply a Sika moisture / vapour barrier.
    - Non-porous substrates, such as steel trowel concrete or compressed fibre cement sheet must be primed with Davco PrimeX
    - Contaminated substrates can be prepared with the use of Davco Ultrabond, the surface must be sound and free of loose material.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Equipment.
    - Personal protective equipment
    - Paint roller with short nap - 10mm
    - Paint brush
4.3 Mixing. Shake the primer prior to use.
4.4 Application.
    - Ultraprime can be applied using a brush or roller
    - Use a paint brush to apply to the corners and any areas of detail. Use a short (10mm) nap roller to apply to the walls and floor
    - Take care to ensure that ponding of the primer doesn’t occur
    - If Ultraprime is being applied to very porous concrete surfaces or in hot / windy conditions, the surface should be wet down prior to the application of the primer. Ensure the water does not pool or pond on the surface, the substrate should appear as a matt finish.
4.5 Cleaning of tools.
    - Clean tools and equipment with water before the primer dries.
    - Product that has dried will require mechanical removal.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test in an inconspicuous area first.
    - Do not use Davco Ultraprime below 5°C or above 35°C as this may affect the curing of the product.
    - Not suitable for steel trowel concrete or compressed fibre cement sheet including ScyonTM - use Davco PrimeX
    - Not suitable for contaminated substrates - use Ultrabond
    - Do not prime an area which cannot be overcoated within 24 hours. If the area is left uncovered for more than 24 hours, it must be re-cleaned, and re-primed before overcoating.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - Do not use Davco Ultraprime below 5°C or above 35°C as this may affect the curing of the product.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test in an inconspicuous area first.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Ultraprime, June 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/davco-ultraprime.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Ultraprime, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sds-davco-ultraprime.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
